plan.english: Mother, I am going over the mountains. The way is far. Take the two grey horses and the new wagon. You give me the best ones! What will you drive? I will drive the old mare. When will you come back? When I have gained fame, I will come back with gifts. May the gods protect you and the horses. Remember your sister!
